extensionDescription.message: Open links in a floating preview over the current page, like Peek in Arc.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension in the extensions page and store.

peekDialogLabel.description: Accessible name of the floating preview.

copyLink.description: Tooltip of the button that copies the previewed page's address.

linkCopied.description: Tooltip shown briefly after the address was copied.

openInNewTab.description: Tooltip of the button that turns the preview into a normal tab.

closePeek.description: Tooltip of the button that closes the preview.

optionsSitesHeading.message: Sites that open links in Peek
optionsSitesHeading.description: Heading of the list of sites in the settings page.

optionsSitesHelp.message: On these sites, clicking a link to another site opens it in Peek. You can also turn a site on or off with the extension's toolbar button.
optionsSitesHelp.description: Explanation under the heading of the site list.

optionsSitePlaceholder.description: Example shown in the empty field where a site is typed.

optionsAddSite.description: Button that adds the typed site to the list.

optionsRemoveSite.description: Button that removes a site from the list.

optionsNoSites.description: Shown when the site list is empty.

optionsInvalidSite.message: Enter a site such as slack.com
optionsInvalidSite.description: Shown when the typed text is not a valid site.

optionsSaved.description: Confirmation shown after a setting changes.

badgeOn.description: Short badge on the toolbar button when Peek is on for the current site. Keep it to 4 characters or fewer.

actionTitleOn.message: Peek is on for $SITE$. Click to turn it off.
actionTitleOn.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button when Peek is on for the current site.

actionTitleOff.message: Click to open links from $SITE$ in Peek.
actionTitleOff.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button when Peek is off for the current site.

actionTitleUnavailable.message: Peek can't run on this page.
actionTitleUnavailable.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button on browser pages where the extension can't run.
